- 2026-06-22: Mapped current producer/consumer. Branch cut off the stateless branch

  Phase 4 (council Redis sink).
- 2026-06-22: **Phase 4 done** (`55e46c9`) — RedisTelemetrySink + publisher fan-out + config;

  `RedisStatsReader` (monitor/server/redis_stats.py) XREVRANGEs the stream and replays into a
  FRESH registry per request → stateless, identical across N monitor replicas; degrades to an
  empty snapshot on redis error (never 500s). `/api/metrics` uses it when
  `MONITOR_STATS_SOURCE=redis` (sentinel-aware `MONITOR_REDIS_*`; stream `MONITOR_STATS_STREAM`);

          run_helm lint deploy/kubernetes/nomos
          run_helm lint deploy/kubernetes/nomos --values deploy/kubernetes/kind-values.yaml
          run_helm template nomos deploy/kubernetes/nomos > /dev/null
          run_helm template nomos deploy/kubernetes/nomos --values deploy/kubernetes/kind-values.yaml > /dev/null

  compose_config:
    name: Compose config
    needs:
      - secret_scan
      - bandit
      - hadolint
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout
        uses: actions/checkout@11d5960a326750d5838078e36cf38b85af677262
        with:
          persist-credentials: false

      - name: Render Compose configuration
        run: docker compose -f deploy/docker-compose.yml config > compose.rendered.yml

      - name: Upload rendered Compose configuration
        if: always()
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@ea165f8d65b6e75b540449e92b4886f43607fa02
        with:
          name: compose-rendered
          path: compose.rendered.yml
          retention-days: 14

  package:
    name: Package
    # Disabled: Nomos does not publish a wheel yet, so nothing consumes this
    # artifact. Re-enable when a release/publish flow exists.
    if: ${{ false }}
    needs:
      - secret_scan
      - bandit
      - hadolint
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    container: python:3.13-slim@sha256:6771159cd4fa5d9bba1258caf0b82e6b73458c694d178ad97c5e925c2d0e1a91
    steps:
      - name: Prepare container
        run: |
          apt-get update
          apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends git
          rm -rf /var/lib/apt/lists/*

      - name: Checkout
        uses: actions/checkout@11d5960a326750d5838078e36cf38b85af677262
        with:
          persist-credentials: false

      - name: Restore Python cache
        uses: actions/cache@0057852bfaa89a56745cba8c7296529d2fc39830
        with:
          path: |
            .cache/uv
            .venv
          key: python-3.13-uv-${{ hashFiles('uv.lock') }}

      - name: Install uv
        uses: astral-sh/setup-uv@37802adc94f370d6bfd71619e3f0bf239e1f3b78
        with:
          version: "0.12.1"
          enable-cache: false

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: |
          python -m pip install --upgrade "pip @ https://files.pythonhosted.org/packages/62/36/a3aed958d60531cb442b7ab4596cda7b3621cfb916f8ae1d6769795c7dc1/pip-26.2-py3-none-any.whl#sha256=931c303696af6fa3417112103b1cad26890e5a07eccb5b99783700e33f2b8aad"
          uv sync --frozen --extra all

      - name: Build package
        run: uv build

      - name: Upload package
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@ea165f8d65b6e75b540449e92b4886f43607fa02
        with:
          name: package
          path: dist/
          retention-days: 14

  docker_build_images:
    name: Docker build images
    # Disabled: images are built at deploy time (docker-compose / kind-up.sh)
    # and CI has no registry to push to. Re-enable alongside a publish target.
    if: ${{ false }}
    needs:
      - secret_scan
      - bandit
      - hadolint
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout
        uses: actions/checkout@11d5960a326750d5838078e36cf38b85af677262
        with:
          persist-credentials: false

      - name: Build images
        run: |
          docker build -f deploy/Dockerfile -t nomos-council:ci .
          docker build -f deploy/Dockerfile.monitor -t nomos-monitor:ci .
          docker build -f deploy/Dockerfile.demo -t nomos-demo:ci .
          docker build -f deploy/Dockerfile.executor -t nomos-executor:ci .
          docker build -f deploy/Dockerfile.openshell -t nomos-openshell:ci .

# Service-mode overlay — brings docker-compose to parity with the Kind deployment:
# PostgreSQL durable store + Vault transit signing (AppRole) + nginx /mcp gateway,
# and flips council/executor/monitor/agent-signup to service mode. Layer it after
# the base + redis-sentinel files (see deploy/scripts/dev-lib.sh `dc()`):
#   docker compose -f docker-compose.yml -f docker-compose.redis-sentinel.yml \
#                  -f docker-compose.service.yml --profile executor-openshell ...
# Driven by deploy/scripts/compose-up.sh (generates secrets, bootstraps Vault).
services:
  # ── in-cluster dev backends ──────────────────────────────────────────
  postgres:
    image: postgres:16-alpine
    restart: unless-stopped
    environment:
      POSTGRES_DB: nomos
      POSTGRES_USER: nomos
      POSTGRES_PASSWORD: ${POSTGRES_PASSWORD:?POSTGRES_PASSWORD is required}
      PGDATA: /var/lib/postgresql/data/pgdata
    volumes:
      - postgres-data:/var/lib/postgresql/data
    networks:
      - nomos-net
    healthcheck:
      test: ["CMD", "pg_isready", "-U", "nomos", "-d", "nomos"]
      interval: 5s
      timeout: 3s
      retries: 20

  vault:
    image: hashicorp/vault:1.17
    restart: unless-stopped
    command: ["server", "-dev", "-dev-listen-address=0.0.0.0:8200"]
    environment:
      VAULT_DEV_ROOT_TOKEN_ID: ${VAULT_DEV_ROOT_TOKEN:-nomos-dev-root}
      VAULT_ADDR: http://127.0.0.1:8200
      # Entrypoint otherwise runs setcap for mlock; dev mode disables mlock.
      SKIP_SETCAP: "true"
    networks:
      - nomos-net
    healthcheck:
      test: ["CMD", "vault", "status"]
      interval: 5s
      timeout: 3s
      retries: 20

  # ── nginx /mcp gateway (token-gated entrypoint, mirrors Kind) ─────────
  council-gateway:
    image: ${GATEWAY_IMAGE:-nginxinc/nginx-unprivileged:1.27-alpine}
    restart: unless-stopped
    depends_on:
      council:
        condition: service_healthy
    ports:
      - "${COUNCIL_GATEWAY_PORT:-9900}:8080"
    environment:
      MCP_PROXY_TOKEN: ${MONITOR_MCP_PROXY_TOKEN:-}
      NGINX_ENVSUBST_FILTER: MCP_PROXY_TOKEN
    volumes:
      - ./nginx/council-gateway.conf.template:/etc/nginx/templates/default.conf.template:ro
    networks:
      - nomos-net
    healthcheck:
      # nginx-unprivileged:alpine ships busybox wget, not curl. Use 127.0.0.1
      # (not localhost) — localhost resolves to ::1 first and nginx listens on IPv4.
      test: ["CMD", "wget", "-q", "-O", "/dev/null", "http://127.0.0.1:8080/healthz"]
      interval: 10s
      timeout: 3s
      retries: 5

  # ── service-mode env overrides (merged onto the base service blocks) ──
  council:
    depends_on:
      postgres:
        condition: service_healthy
      vault:
        condition: service_healthy
    environment:
      COUNCIL_STORAGE_MODE: postgres
      COUNCIL_DATABASE_URL: postgresql://nomos:${POSTGRES_PASSWORD_URLENCODED:?POSTGRES_PASSWORD_URLENCODED is required}@postgres:5432/nomos
      NOMOS_SIGNER_PROVIDER: vault
      COUNCIL_SIGNER_KEY_ID: nomos-council
      NOMOS_VAULT_ADDR: http://vault:8200
      NOMOS_VAULT_TRANSIT_MOUNT: transit
      VAULT_ROLE_ID: ${VAULT_ROLE_ID:-}
      VAULT_SECRET_ID: ${VAULT_SECRET_ID:-}

  executor-openshell:
    depends_on:
      council:
        condition: service_healthy
      vault:
        condition: service_healthy
      openshell:
        condition: service_healthy
    environment:
      NOMOS_SIGNER_PROVIDER: vault
      EXECUTOR_SIGNER_KEY_ID: nomos-executor
      EXECUTOR_COUNCIL_URL: http://council:9901
      NOMOS_VAULT_ADDR: http://vault:8200
      NOMOS_VAULT_TRANSIT_MOUNT: transit
      VAULT_ROLE_ID: ${VAULT_ROLE_ID:-}
      VAULT_SECRET_ID: ${VAULT_SECRET_ID:-}

  monitor:
    environment:
      MONITOR_LEDGER_SOURCE: api
      MONITOR_LEDGER_API_URL: http://council:9901

  agent-signup:
    depends_on:
      postgres:
        condition: service_healthy
      monitor:
        condition: service_healthy
    environment:
      COUNCIL_STORAGE_MODE: postgres
      COUNCIL_DATABASE_URL: postgresql://nomos:${POSTGRES_PASSWORD_URLENCODED:?POSTGRES_PASSWORD_URLENCODED is required}@postgres:5432/nomos

volumes:
  postgres-data:
    driver: local

# ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
# Nomos — Docker Compose Stack
#
# Services:
#   - redis:    Persistent key-value store (nonces, accounts, writs)
#   - opa:      Optional Open Policy Agent sidecar for intent filtering
#   - council:  MCP server with LLM-backed security council (internal-only)
#   - monitor:  Reverse proxy + observability dashboard; publishes :9901
#               externally and forwards MCP traffic to council.
#   - council-grpc: gRPC proxy for the council MCP server (port 9904).
#               Routes through monitor so unified request stats include gRPC.
#   - agent-signup: Local account signup UI/API (port 9905).
#   - executor: Writ executor sandbox (profile-selectable configs)
#
# Executor profiles:
#   executor-openshell                — Default trusted OpenShell adapter (host port 9907)
#   openshell                         — Internal OpenShell-compatible runtime backend
#   executor-default                  — Restrictive baseline Docker executor (port 9902)
#   executor-dev — development executor, host bind mounts (port 9903)
#
# Usage:
#   # Core infra (always needed):
#   docker compose -f deploy/docker-compose.yml up -d redis opa council monitor council-grpc
#
#   # Bundled OPA filtering is enabled by default:
#   docker compose -f deploy/docker-compose.yml up -d redis opa council monitor council-grpc
#   OPA_POLICY_DIR=/path/to/policies docker compose -f deploy/docker-compose.yml up -d redis opa council monitor council-grpc
#
#   # Or point council at an external/custom OPA:
#   COUNCIL_OPA_URL=https://opa.example.internal docker compose -f deploy/docker-compose.yml up -d redis council monitor council-grpc
#
#   # Start an executor profile:
#   docker compose -f deploy/docker-compose.yml --profile executor-openshell up -d
#   docker compose -f deploy/docker-compose.yml --profile executor-default up -d
#   docker compose -f deploy/docker-compose.yml --profile executor-dev up -d
#
#   # Or start everything with the default trusted executor:
#   docker compose -f deploy/docker-compose.yml --profile executor-openshell up -d
#
#   # Redis Sentinel topology:
#   docker compose -f deploy/docker-compose.yml -f deploy/docker-compose.redis-sentinel.yml \
#     --profile executor-openshell up -d
#   # Or use deploy_stack; Sentinel is the default Compose topology:
#   DEPLOY_TARGET=compose ./scripts/deploy_stack.sh
#
# Manage accounts from a Docker-only host:
#   ./scripts/agent_accounts.sh create alice-agent --role developer
#
# Notes:
#   - Published service ports bind externally by default for remote deployments.
#   - Council key pair persists across restarts via volume mount
#   - Redis data persists across restarts via volume mount
#   - The bundled profiles use different host ports (9902, 9903, 9907), so they
#     can run together if that suits your workflow.
# ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

# ── Shared executor settings (YAML anchor) ───────────────────
x-executor-base: &executor-base
  build:
    context: ..
    dockerfile: deploy/Dockerfile.executor
  restart: unless-stopped
  user: "${EXECUTOR_UID:-10001}:${EXECUTOR_GID:-10001}"
  depends_on:
    redis:
      condition: service_healthy
  networks:
    - nomos-net
  cap_drop:
    - ALL
  security_opt:
    - no-new-privileges:true
  read_only: true
  tmpfs:
    - /tmp:noexec,nosuid,size=256m
  healthcheck:
    test: ["CMD", "curl", "-sf", "http://localhost:9902/v1/health"]
    interval: 15s
    timeout: 3s
    start_period: 5s
    retries: 3

services:
  redis:
    image: redis:7-alpine
    restart: unless-stopped
    command: redis-server --appendonly yes --requirepass ${REDIS_PASSWORD:-nomos-dev}
    ports:
      - "${REDIS_BIND_ADDR:-0.0.0.0}:${REDIS_PORT:-6379}:6379"
    volumes:
      - redis-data:/data
    networks:
      - nomos-net
    healthcheck:
      test: ["CMD", "redis-cli", "-a", "${REDIS_PASSWORD:-nomos-dev}", "ping"]
      interval: 10s
      timeout: 3s
      retries: 5
      start_period: 5s

  opa:
    image: ${OPA_IMAGE:-openpolicyagent/opa:latest}
    restart: unless-stopped
    command:
      [
        "run",
        "--server",
        "--addr=0.0.0.0:8181",
        "--log-level=${OPA_LOG_LEVEL:-info}",
        "/policies",
      ]
    ports:
      - "${OPA_BIND_ADDR:-0.0.0.0}:${OPA_PORT:-8181}:8181"
    volumes:
      - ${OPA_POLICY_DIR:-../policies}:/policies:ro
    networks:
      - opa-net

  council:
    build:
      context: ..
      dockerfile: deploy/Dockerfile
    restart: unless-stopped
    depends_on:
      redis:
        condition: service_healthy
    # Council MCP is reachable only on the docker network. External MCP
    # traffic enters via the `monitor` service, which proxies it here.
    expose:
      - "9901"
    environment:
      - NOMOS_DEPLOY_PROFILE=${NOMOS_DEPLOY_PROFILE:-dev}
      - NOMOS_ALPHA_ALLOW_PUBLIC_BIND=${NOMOS_ALPHA_ALLOW_PUBLIC_BIND:-false}
      - ANTHROPIC_API_KEY=${ANTHROPIC_API_KEY:-}
      - NVIDIA_API_KEY=${NVIDIA_API_KEY:-}
      - OPENAI_API_KEY=${OPENAI_API_KEY:-}
      # Redis is accessible via the Docker network hostname
      - COUNCIL_REDIS_HOST=redis
      - COUNCIL_REDIS_PORT=6379
      - COUNCIL_REDIS_PASSWORD=${REDIS_PASSWORD:-nomos-dev}
      - COUNCIL_REDIS_ACCOUNT_INTEGRITY_KEY=${COUNCIL_REDIS_ACCOUNT_INTEGRITY_KEY:-}
      # OPA is enabled by default. Either run the bundled opa service or point
      # COUNCIL_OPA_URL at an external/custom OPA deployment.
      - COUNCIL_OPA_ENABLED=${COUNCIL_OPA_ENABLED:-true}
      - COUNCIL_OPA_URL=${COUNCIL_OPA_URL:-http://opa:8181}
      - COUNCIL_OPA_DECISION_PATH=${COUNCIL_OPA_DECISION_PATH:-/v1/data/nomos/intent/decision}
      - COUNCIL_OPA_POLICY_ID=${COUNCIL_OPA_POLICY_ID:-strict-shell}
      - GIT_WORKFLOW_COUNCIL_OPA_POLICY_ID=${GIT_WORKFLOW_COUNCIL_OPA_POLICY_ID:-git-workflow-local}
      - COUNCIL_OPA_TIMEOUT_MS=${COUNCIL_OPA_TIMEOUT_MS:-500}
      - COUNCIL_OPA_FAIL_CLOSED=${COUNCIL_OPA_FAIL_CLOSED:-true}
      - COUNCIL_TELEMETRY_ENABLED=${COUNCIL_TELEMETRY_ENABLED:-true}
      - COUNCIL_TELEMETRY_URL=${COUNCIL_TELEMETRY_URL:-http://monitor:9901/internal/council-latency}
      - COUNCIL_TELEMETRY_TOKEN=${MONITOR_INTERNAL_TOKEN:-nomos-dev-telemetry}
      - COUNCIL_TELEMETRY_TIMEOUT_MS=${COUNCIL_TELEMETRY_TIMEOUT_MS:-250}
      - COUNCIL_ALLOW_UNCERTIFIED_EVIDENCE=${COUNCIL_ALLOW_UNCERTIFIED_EVIDENCE:-true}
      - COUNCIL_CATALOG_PATH=/app/dynamic-config/local_council_catalog.yaml
      - COUNCIL_DYNAMIC_PROFILE_DIR=/app/dynamic-config/councils
      - COUNCIL_DYNAMIC_LEDGER_DIR=/app/ledger
      - COUNCIL_MANAGEMENT_TOKEN=${COUNCIL_MANAGEMENT_TOKEN:-}
      - COUNCIL_PUBLIC_KEY_EXPORT_PATH=/app/public-keys/council.pub
    volumes:
      - ${COUNCIL_CONFIG_FILE:-../configs/council.yaml}:/app/configs/council.yaml:ro
      - council-keys:/app/keys
      - council-public-keys:/app/public-keys
      - council-ledger:/app/ledger
      - ./dynamic-config:/app/dynamic-config
    networks:
      - nomos-net
      - opa-net
    healthcheck:
      test: ["CMD", "curl", "-sf", "http://localhost:9901/debug/tools/list"]
      interval: 30s
      timeout: 5s
      start_period: 15s
      retries: 3

  # ── Council Monitor: proxy + observability dashboard ────────
  # Binds the externally visible MCP port (9901) and forwards traffic
  # to the internal council:9901. Records per-request timing and
  # X-Council-Source attribution. Dashboard at http://localhost:9901/.
  monitor:
    build:
      context: ..
      dockerfile: deploy/Dockerfile.monitor
    restart: unless-stopped
    depends_on:
      council:
        condition: service_healthy
    ports:
      - "${MONITOR_PORT:-9901}:9901"
    environment:
      - NOMOS_DEPLOY_PROFILE=${NOMOS_DEPLOY_PROFILE:-dev}
      - MONITOR_UPSTREAM=http://council:9901/mcp
      - MONITOR_UPSTREAM_HEALTH=http://council:9901/debug/tools/list
      - MONITOR_INTERNAL_TOKEN=${MONITOR_INTERNAL_TOKEN:-nomos-dev-telemetry}
      - MONITOR_DASHBOARD_USER=${MONITOR_DASHBOARD_USER:-admin}
      - MONITOR_DASHBOARD_PASSWORD=${MONITOR_DASHBOARD_PASSWORD:-}
      - MONITOR_MCP_PROXY_TOKEN=${MONITOR_MCP_PROXY_TOKEN:-}
      - MONITOR_LEDGER_PATHS=${MONITOR_LEDGER_PATHS:-/app/ledger/*.jsonl}
    volumes:
      - council-ledger:/app/ledger:ro
    networks:
      - nomos-net
    healthcheck:
      # /livez is process-only (see monitor/server/main.py). /healthz round-trips to
      # the council and 503s while it warms — probing it would flap the monitor on
      # any council blip even though the proxy is serving (502s) normally.
      test: ["CMD", "curl", "-sf", "http://localhost:9901/livez"]
      interval: 15s
      timeout: 3s
      start_period: 10s
      retries: 3

  council-grpc:
    build:
      context: ..
      dockerfile: deploy/Dockerfile
    restart: unless-stopped
    depends_on:
      monitor:
        condition: service_healthy
    ports:
      - "${COUNCIL_GRPC_BIND_ADDR:-0.0.0.0}:${COUNCIL_GRPC_PORT:-9904}:9904"
    environment:
      # Forward through monitor so gRPC traffic appears in unified stats
      # alongside direct MCP and the demo. The gRPC proxy tags outbound
      # MCP requests with X-Council-Source: grpc.
      - COUNCIL_MCP_URL=http://monitor:9901/mcp
      - COUNCIL_MCP_PROXY_TOKEN=${MONITOR_MCP_PROXY_TOKEN:-}
      - COUNCIL_GRPC_HOST=0.0.0.0
      - COUNCIL_GRPC_PORT=9904
    entrypoint: ["python", "-m", "nomos.grpc.server"]
    networks:
      - nomos-net
    healthcheck:
      test:
        [
          "CMD-SHELL",
          "python -c \"import grpc; from nomos.grpc.v1 import council_pb2, council_pb2_grpc; channel=grpc.insecure_channel('localhost:9904'); stub=council_pb2_grpc.CouncilProxyStub(channel); raise SystemExit(0 if stub.Health(council_pb2.HealthRequest(), timeout=3).ok else 1)\"",
        ]
      interval: 30s
      timeout: 5s
      start_period: 15s
      retries: 3

  # ── Agent Signup: account provisioning UI/API ───────────────
  # Creates Redis-backed agent accounts and displays the one-time
  # token plus the externally visible council endpoint.
  agent-signup:
    build:
      context: ..
      dockerfile: deploy/Dockerfile.agent-signup
    restart: unless-stopped
    depends_on:
      redis:
        condition: service_healthy
      monitor:
        condition: service_healthy
    ports:
      - "${AGENT_SIGNUP_BIND_ADDR:-0.0.0.0}:${AGENT_SIGNUP_PORT:-9905}:9905"
    environment:
      - NOMOS_DEPLOY_PROFILE=${NOMOS_DEPLOY_PROFILE:-dev}
      - NOMOS_SIGNUP_REDIS_URL=redis://:${REDIS_PASSWORD:-nomos-dev}@redis:6379/0
      - NOMOS_SIGNUP_REDIS_PREFIX=${NOMOS_REDIS_PREFIX:-nomos:}
      - NOMOS_ACCOUNT_INTEGRITY_KEY=${COUNCIL_REDIS_ACCOUNT_INTEGRITY_KEY:-}
      - NOMOS_SIGNUP_COUNCIL_ID=${NOMOS_SIGNUP_COUNCIL_ID:-council-prod}
      - NOMOS_SIGNUP_ALLOWED_COUNCILS=${NOMOS_SIGNUP_ALLOWED_COUNCILS:-council-prod}
      - NOMOS_SIGNUP_DEFAULT_ROLE=${NOMOS_SIGNUP_DEFAULT_ROLE:-developer}
      - NOMOS_SIGNUP_ALLOWED_ROLES=${NOMOS_SIGNUP_ALLOWED_ROLES:-readonly,developer}
      - NOMOS_SIGNUP_COUNCIL_ENDPOINT=http://${NOMOS_PUBLIC_HOST:-localhost}:${MONITOR_PORT:-9901}/mcp
      - NOMOS_SIGNUP_ADMIN_USER=${NOMOS_SIGNUP_ADMIN_USER:-admin}
      - NOMOS_SIGNUP_ADMIN_PASSWORD=${NOMOS_SIGNUP_ADMIN_PASSWORD:-}
    networks:
      - nomos-net
    healthcheck:
      test: ["CMD", "curl", "-ksf", "https://localhost:9905/healthz"]
      interval: 15s
      timeout: 3s
      start_period: 10s
      retries: 3

  # ── Council Chamber demo (FastAPI + static SPA) ──────────────
  # Stateless proxy in front of the council and executor for the
  # interactive demo UI. Reads agent tokens from deploy/.env.
  demo:
    build:
      context: ..
      dockerfile: deploy/Dockerfile.demo
    restart: unless-stopped
    depends_on:
      monitor:
        condition: service_healthy
    ports:
      - "${DEMO_PORT:-8000}:8000"
    environment:
      # Route through the monitor so demo traffic shows up in unified stats.
      # The demo's CouncilClient sets X-Council-Source: demo and authenticates
      # to the monitor with the same bearer token the monitor validates.
      - NOMOS_COUNCIL_URL=http://monitor:9901/mcp
      - MONITOR_MCP_PROXY_TOKEN=${MONITOR_MCP_PROXY_TOKEN:-}
      - NOMOS_EXECUTOR_URL=${NOMOS_EXECUTOR_URL:-http://executor-openshell:9906}
      - NOMOS_WORKSPACE=/workspace
      - DEMO_AUTH_USER=${DEMO_AUTH_USER:-demo}
      - DEMO_AUTH_PASSWORD=${DEMO_AUTH_PASSWORD:-}
      - NOMOS_AUTH_TOKEN_K8S_ADMIN=${NOMOS_AUTH_TOKEN_K8S_ADMIN:-}
      - NOMOS_AUTH_TOKEN_K8S_DEV=${NOMOS_AUTH_TOKEN_K8S_DEV:-}
      - NOMOS_AUTH_TOKEN_K8S_READONLY=${NOMOS_AUTH_TOKEN_K8S_READONLY:-}
      - NOMOS_AUTH_TOKEN=${NOMOS_AUTH_TOKEN:-}
      - NOMOS_AGENT_ID=${NOMOS_AGENT_ID:-}
    networks:
      - nomos-net
    healthcheck:
      test: ["CMD", "curl", "-ksf", "https://localhost:8000/api/health"]
      interval: 15s
      timeout: 3s
      start_period: 10s
      retries: 3

  # ── Executor: default (restrictive baseline) ─────────────────
  executor-default:
    <<: *executor-base
    profiles: ["executor-default"]
    ports:
      - "${EXECUTOR_DEFAULT_PORT:-9902}:9902"
    environment:
      - EXECUTOR_PUBLIC_KEY_PATH=/app/public-keys/council.pub
      - EXECUTOR_REDIS_URL=redis://:${REDIS_PASSWORD:-nomos-dev}@redis:6379/0
      - EXECUTOR_HOST=0.0.0.0
      - EXECUTOR_PORT=9902
      - EXECUTOR_CONTAINER_MODE=1
      - EXECUTOR_CONFIG=/app/config/executor.yaml
      - EXECUTOR_PRIVATE_KEY_PATH=/app/executor-keys/executor.key
      - EXECUTOR_PUBLIC_KEY_EXPORT_PATH=/app/executor-keys/executor.pub
    volumes:

#!/usr/bin/env bash
# SPDX-FileCopyrightText: Copyright (c) 2026 NVIDIA CORPORATION & AFFILIATES. All rights reserved.
# SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
#
# Verify a running Nomos docker-compose dev stack: service health, council MCP,
# gateway token-gate, monitor/signup health, Postgres durable state, and a full
# functional flow (authorize -> writ -> execute -> signed evidence via Vault transit).
# Exits non-zero on any hard failure. Runnable standalone after compose-up.sh.
#
#   deploy/scripts/compose-verify.sh
# Env: AGENT_ID, AGENT_TOKEN (default: NOMOS_* from deploy/.env)
set -Eeuo pipefail
SCRIPT_DIR="$(cd "$(dirname "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")" && pwd)"
# shellcheck source=./dev-lib.sh
. "$SCRIPT_DIR/dev-lib.sh"

# This script verifies the SERVICE topology, whose postgres, vault and
# council-gateway services are defined only in docker-compose.service.yml. dc()
# selects overlays from the environment (mirroring scripts/deploy_stack.sh), so
# declare the overlay here exactly as compose-up.sh/compose-down.sh do. Without
# it a standalone re-run (compose-up.sh exports COMPOSE_EXTRA_FILES only to the
# verify it spawns) gets "no such service: postgres" from `dc ps` and fails the
# service-mode checks on a correctly deployed stack.
# Prepend rather than overwrite, so an explicit COMPOSE_EXTRA_FILES still applies.
SERVICE_OVERLAY="$ROOT_DIR/deploy/docker-compose.service.yml"
if [[ ":${COMPOSE_EXTRA_FILES:-}:" != *":$SERVICE_OVERLAY:"* ]]; then
  COMPOSE_EXTRA_FILES="${COMPOSE_EXTRA_FILES:+$COMPOSE_EXTRA_FILES:}$SERVICE_OVERLAY"
fi
export COMPOSE_EXTRA_FILES

AGENT_ID="${AGENT_ID:-${NOMOS_AGENT_ID:-$(env_get NOMOS_AGENT_ID)}}"
AGENT_ID="${AGENT_ID:-dev-agent}"
AGENT_TOKEN="${AGENT_TOKEN:-$(env_get NOMOS_AUTH_TOKEN)}"
PROXY_TOKEN="$(env_get MONITOR_MCP_PROXY_TOKEN)"
GATEWAY_PORT="$(env_get COUNCIL_GATEWAY_PORT)"; GATEWAY_PORT="${GATEWAY_PORT:-9900}"
MONITOR_PORT="$(env_get MONITOR_PORT)"; MONITOR_PORT="${MONITOR_PORT:-9901}"
SIGNUP_PORT="$(env_get AGENT_SIGNUP_PORT)"; SIGNUP_PORT="${SIGNUP_PORT:-9905}"

PASS=0; FAIL=0
pass() { ok "$1"; PASS=$((PASS + 1)); }
fail() { printf '  %s\xe2\x9c\x97%s %s\n' "$C_R" "$C_0" "$1" >&2; FAIL=$((FAIL + 1)); }
check() { local label="$1"; shift; if "$@" >/dev/null 2>&1; then pass "$label"; else fail "$label"; fi; }

_svc_healthy() {
  local cid state
  cid="$(dc ps -q "$1" 2>/dev/null | head -n1)"; [[ -n "$cid" ]] || return 1
  state="$(docker inspect -f '{{if .State.Health}}{{.State.Health.Status}}{{else}}{{.State.Status}}{{end}}' "$cid" 2>/dev/null || echo none)"
  [[ "$state" = healthy || "$state" = running ]]
}
_code() { curl -sk -o /dev/null -m 8 -w '%{http_code}' "$@"; }
# Gateway/monitor checks as functions so `check` runs them in-process (a `bash -c`
# subshell would not see _code or the script globals).
_gw_healthz()  { [[ "$(_code "http://localhost:${GATEWAY_PORT}/healthz")" = 200 ]]; }
_gw_noauth()   { [[ "$(_code -X POST "http://localhost:${GATEWAY_PORT}/mcp")" = 401 ]]; }
_gw_auth()     { local c; c="$(_code -X POST -H "Authorization: Bearer ${PROXY_TOKEN}" "http://localhost:${GATEWAY_PORT}/mcp")"; [[ "$c" != 401 && "$c" != 000 ]]; }
_monitor_up()  { [[ "$(_code "http://localhost:${MONITOR_PORT}/")" != 000 ]]; }

log "Verifying Nomos compose stack (project: $COMPOSE_PROJECT)"

# Every check below assumes the service topology compose-up.sh deploys. The
# default `DEPLOY_TARGET=compose scripts/deploy_stack.sh` deploy is the redis
# topology: no postgres, vault or council-gateway, so those checks fail and the
# in-container flow dies resolving council-gateway with nothing naming the cause.
# Detect by container label so this does not depend on overlays or deploy/.env
# (the service overlay cannot even be interpolated without POSTGRES_PASSWORD).
# -a: a stopped postgres still identifies the topology; the health check below
# then reports it as unhealthy instead of this guard misreporting the topology.
if [[ -z "$(docker ps -aq --filter "label=com.docker.compose.project=$COMPOSE_PROJECT" \
                           --filter "label=com.docker.compose.service=postgres")" ]]; then
  die "compose-verify.sh requires the service topology (postgres + vault + council-gateway)," \
    "but project '$COMPOSE_PROJECT' has no postgres container. Run deploy/scripts/compose-up.sh first;" \
    "scripts/deploy_stack.sh deploys the redis topology, which this script does not verify."
fi

# ── service health ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────
log "Service health"
check "postgres healthy" _svc_healthy postgres
check "vault healthy"    _svc_healthy vault
for s in redis redis-1 redis-2 redis-sentinel-1 redis-sentinel-2 redis-sentinel-3 \
         council council-gateway council-grpc monitor executor-openshell openshell opa; do
  check "service $s healthy" _svc_healthy "$s"
done
if _svc_healthy agent-signup; then pass "service agent-signup healthy"
else warn "service agent-signup NOT healthy (service-mode console); non-fatal"; fi

# ── council MCP + gateway token-gate ─────────────────────────────────────
log "Council MCP + gateway"
check "council MCP tools registered" dc exec -T council \
  python -c "import urllib.request,sys; d=urllib.request.urlopen('http://localhost:9901/debug/tools/list',timeout=8).read(); sys.exit(0 if b'council_' in d else 1)"
check "gateway /healthz = 200"          _gw_healthz
check "gateway /mcp no-bearer = 401"    _gw_noauth
check "gateway /mcp with-bearer != 401" _gw_auth
check "monitor reachable"               _monitor_up
if [[ "$(_code "https://localhost:${SIGNUP_PORT}/healthz" 2>/dev/null)" = 200 ]]; then
  pass "agent-signup /healthz = 200"
else warn "agent-signup /healthz != 200; non-fatal"; fi

# ── durable state ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
log "Postgres durable state"
acct_ok=$(dc exec -T council python -c "
import asyncio,os
from nomos.store.postgres_store import PostgresStore
async def m():
    s=PostgresStore(os.environ['COUNCIL_DATABASE_URL']); await s.connect()
    n=len(await s.list_account_ids()); await s.close(); print(n)
asyncio.run(m())" 2>/dev/null | tail -n1 || echo 0)
if [[ "${acct_ok:-0}" -ge 1 ]]; then pass "Postgres has >=1 registered account ($acct_ok)"; else fail "Postgres has no accounts (registration?)"; fi

# ── functional: authorize -> writ -> execute -> evidence ──────────────────
log "Functional flow (authorize -> writ -> execute -> signed evidence)"
if [[ -z "$AGENT_TOKEN" ]]; then
  fail "no AGENT_TOKEN available — cannot run the functional flow"
else
  # Driven from INSIDE the council container, addressing peers over the docker
  # network: the gateway at council-gateway:8080 and the executor at its container
  # listen port executor-openshell:9906 (the host publishes 9907 -> 9906). Kind's
  # equivalent hits the executor Service at 9907 instead — see kind-verify.sh.
  cat > /tmp/nomos_compose_e2e.py <<'PY'
import asyncio, json, os, sys, httpx
from mcp import ClientSession
from mcp.client.streamable_http import streamablehttp_client
GW = "http://council-gateway:8080/mcp"
EXEC = "http://executor-openshell:9906/v1/writs/execute"
TOKEN, PROXY = sys.argv[1], sys.argv[2]
async def main():
    async with streamablehttp_client(GW, headers={"Authorization": "Bearer " + PROXY}) as (r, w, _):
        async with ClientSession(r, w) as s:
            await s.initialize()
            out = json.loads((await s.call_tool("council_authorize", arguments={
                "agent_id": os.environ.get("AGENT_ID", "dev-agent"), "auth_token": TOKEN,
                "council_id": "council-prod", "command": "/bin/echo nomos-verify",
                "working_directory": "/workspace",
                "description": "Print a constant string to verify the execution path.",
                "target_resource": "shell://dev/echo", "target_environment": "development",
                "justification": "compose-verify end-to-end smoke.",
                "blast_radius": "None; prints a constant, no state change."})).content[0].text)
            if out.get("status") != "approved" or not out.get("writ"):
                print("AUTHORIZE_FAIL status=%s err=%s" % (out.get("status"), (out.get("error") or "")[:200])); sys.exit(1)
            print("AUTHORIZE_OK members=%d risk=%s" % (len(out.get("council_members", [])), (out.get("chairman") or {}).get("risk_level")))
            async with httpx.AsyncClient(timeout=40) as c:
                ej = (await c.post(EXEC, json={"writ": out["writ"]}, headers={"X-Agent-ID": os.environ.get("AGENT_ID", "dev-agent")})).json()
            if not ej.get("success") or "evidence" not in ej:
                print("EXECUTE_FAIL success=%s keys=%s" % (ej.get("success"), sorted(ej.keys()))); sys.exit(1)
            print("EXECUTE_OK exit=%s stdout=%r evidence=yes" % (ej.get("exit_code"), (ej.get("stdout") or "").strip()))
asyncio.run(main())
PY
  POD="$(dc ps -q council | head -n1)"
  docker cp /tmp/nomos_compose_e2e.py "$POD":/tmp/nomos_compose_e2e.py >/dev/null 2>&1
  if out="$(dc exec -T -e AGENT_ID="$AGENT_ID" council python /tmp/nomos_compose_e2e.py "$AGENT_TOKEN" "$PROXY_TOKEN" 2>&1)"; then
    echo "$out" | grep -q "AUTHORIZE_OK" && pass "authorize approved + writ minted ($(echo "$out" | grep AUTHORIZE_OK))"
    echo "$out" | grep -q "EXECUTE_OK"   && pass "executed + signed evidence ($(echo "$out" | grep EXECUTE_OK))" || fail "execute/evidence failed: $(echo "$out" | tail -n1)"
  else
    fail "functional flow failed: $(echo "$out" | tail -n2 | tr '\n' ' ')"
  fi
  rm -f /tmp/nomos_compose_e2e.py
fi

# ── verdict ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
echo
if [[ "$FAIL" -eq 0 ]]; then
  log "${C_G}VERIFY PASSED${C_0} — $PASS checks OK"
else
  die "VERIFY FAILED — $FAIL failed, $PASS passed"
fi

# the environment (mirroring scripts/deploy_stack.sh) rather than hard-coding that

# either service and every later dc call runs without the service-mode overrides.
# Prepend rather than overwrite, so an explicit COMPOSE_EXTRA_FILES still applies.

  COMPOSE_EXTRA_FILES="${COMPOSE_EXTRA_FILES:+$COMPOSE_EXTRA_FILES:}$SERVICE_OVERLAY"

SKIP_BUILD="${SKIP_BUILD:-0}"
AGENT_ID="${AGENT_ID:-dev-agent}"
while [[ $# -gt 0 ]]; do

    -y|--yes) NONINTERACTIVE=1 ;;
    --skip-build) SKIP_BUILD=1 ;;
    --regenerate-secrets) REGENERATE_SECRETS=1 ;;
    --agent-id) AGENT_ID="${2:?}"; shift ;;
    --agent-id=*) AGENT_ID="${1#*=}" ;;

GATEWAY_PORT="$(env_get COUNCIL_GATEWAY_PORT)"; GATEWAY_PORT="${GATEWAY_PORT:-9900}"

# Concise, actionable failure for a compose service (never a bare "did not become
# healthy"): what failed, its state, the last log line, and the command to dig in.
_compose_diag() {
  local svc="$1" cid="$2" state="$3" elapsed="$4" last
  printf '  %s\xe2\x9c\x97%s %s not healthy (state: %s) after %ss\n' "$C_R" "$C_0" "$svc" "${state:-unknown}" "$elapsed" >&2
  if [[ -n "$cid" ]]; then
    last="$(docker logs --tail=3 "$cid" 2>&1 | tail -n1 | cut -c1-160)"
    [[ -n "$last" ]] && warn "last log: $last"
    warn "→ docker logs --tail=50 $cid"
  else
    warn "no container for $svc yet — docker compose -p $COMPOSE_PROJECT ps"
  fi
}

# Wait until a compose service reports healthy (or running, if it has no healthcheck).
# On timeout/exit it prints _compose_diag then PROMPTS (confirm_wait) — it does not
# auto-fail; it only returns non-zero when the operator gives up.
wait_healthy() {
  local svc="$1" timeout="${2:-180}" cid state="none" i
  while :; do
    i=0
    while [[ "$i" -lt "$timeout" ]]; do
      cid="$(dc ps -q "$svc" 2>/dev/null | head -n1)"
      if [[ -n "$cid" ]]; then
        state="$(docker inspect -f '{{if .State.Health}}{{.State.Health.Status}}{{else}}{{.State.Status}}{{end}}' "$cid" 2>/dev/null || echo starting)"
        [[ "$state" = healthy ]] && return 0
        [[ "$state" = running ]] && return 0
        [[ "$state" = exited ]] && break
      fi
      sleep 1; i=$((i + 1))
    done
    _compose_diag "$svc" "$(dc ps -q "$svc" 2>/dev/null | head -n1)" "$state" "$i"
    confirm_wait "$svc not healthy" 120 || return 1
    timeout=120
  done
}

# ── 1. preflight ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
log "[1/9] Preflight"
require_cmd docker
docker info >/dev/null 2>&1 || die "docker daemon is not available"
docker compose version >/dev/null 2>&1 || die "docker compose (v2 plugin) is required"
ok "docker / docker compose present"

log "[2/9] LLM API key (required — the council validates llm_backends at boot)"

ok "LLM key present (stored in $ENV_FILE)"

# ── 3. dev secrets (generate + persist) ─────────────────────────────────
log "[3/9] Dev secrets (auto-generated, persisted to deploy/.env)"
# Same set as kind-up.sh plus DEMO_AUTH_PASSWORD — compose runs the demo service
# (the Kind chart does not). compose substitutes these into the stack from deploy/.env.
for k in REDIS_PASSWORD COUNCIL_REDIS_ACCOUNT_INTEGRITY_KEY COUNCIL_MANAGEMENT_TOKEN \
         MONITOR_INTERNAL_TOKEN MONITOR_MCP_PROXY_TOKEN MONITOR_DASHBOARD_PASSWORD \
         NOMOS_SIGNUP_ADMIN_PASSWORD NOMOS_SIGNUP_COUNCIL_ADMIN_PASSWORD \
         DEMO_AUTH_PASSWORD POSTGRES_PASSWORD VAULT_DEV_ROOT_TOKEN; do
  gen_or_keep "$k" >/dev/null
done
sync_postgres_url_password
default_or_keep MONITOR_DASHBOARD_USER admin >/dev/null
default_or_keep NOMOS_SIGNUP_ADMIN_USER admin >/dev/null
default_or_keep NOMOS_SIGNUP_COUNCIL_ADMIN_USER council-admin >/dev/null
ok "secrets ready ($([[ "$REGENERATE_SECRETS" = 1 ]] && echo regenerated || echo 'generated if missing'))"

# ── 4. council catalog ──────────────────────────────────────────────────
# The base compose mounts deploy/dynamic-config at /app/dynamic-config; seed the
# read-only council catalog the same way scripts/deploy_stack.sh does.
log "[4/9] Council catalog (deploy/dynamic-config)"
DCFG="$ROOT_DIR/deploy/dynamic-config"
mkdir -p "$DCFG/councils"
[[ -f "$DCFG/local_council_catalog.yaml" ]] || cp "$ROOT_DIR/configs/local_council_catalog.yaml" "$DCFG/local_council_catalog.yaml"
for c in council.yaml git_workflow_council.yaml; do
  [[ -f "$ROOT_DIR/configs/$c" && ! -f "$DCFG/$c" ]] && cp "$ROOT_DIR/configs/$c" "$DCFG/$c" || true
done
ok "catalog present"

# ── 5. backends ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
log "[5/9] Start backends (postgres + vault)"
dc up -d postgres vault
wait_healthy postgres 120 || die "postgres did not become healthy"
wait_healthy vault 120 || die "vault did not become healthy"
sync_postgres_role_password
ok "backends healthy"

# ── 6. vault bootstrap (transit + AppRole) ──────────────────────────────
# The dev Vault is in-memory, so every run (re)bootstraps it (idempotent) and mints
# a fresh AppRole secret-id. The resulting env change makes step 7's `up` recreate
# council/executor with the new credentials — expected on idempotent re-runs.
log "[6/9] Bootstrap Vault transit signing (AppRole)"
boot="$(dc exec -T -e VAULT_TOKEN="$(env_get VAULT_DEV_ROOT_TOKEN)" -e TRANSIT_MOUNT=transit \
  vault sh -s < "$SCRIPT_DIR/vault-bootstrap-compose.sh")"
role="$(printf '%s\n' "$boot" | sed -n 's/^VAULT_ROLE_ID=//p' | tail -n1)"
secret="$(printf '%s\n' "$boot" | sed -n 's/^VAULT_SECRET_ID=//p' | tail -n1)"
[[ -n "$role" && -n "$secret" ]] || die "vault bootstrap did not return AppRole credentials"
env_set VAULT_ROLE_ID "$role"; env_set VAULT_SECRET_ID "$secret"
unset boot role secret
ok "transit keys + AppRole ready (role/secret id persisted to deploy/.env)"

# ── 7. deploy the stack ─────────────────────────────────────────────────
# Stage the bring-up: let the redis-sentinel topology settle (nodes sync as
# replicas, then the sentinels) before the council starts. A cold all-at-once
# `up` races the nodes' replica-sync against their healthchecks and compose
# aborts the whole command when a node is briefly unhealthy.
log "[7/9] Bring up the service-mode stack"
dc up -d redis redis-1 redis-2
for s in redis redis-1 redis-2; do wait_healthy "$s" 120 || die "$s did not become healthy"; done
dc up -d redis-sentinel-1 redis-sentinel-2 redis-sentinel-3
for s in redis-sentinel-1 redis-sentinel-2 redis-sentinel-3; do wait_healthy "$s" 90 || die "$s did not become healthy"; done
if [[ "$SKIP_BUILD" = "1" ]]; then
  dc up -d
else
  dc up -d --build
fi
ok "stack started"

# ── 8. waits ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
log "[8/9] Wait for council + workloads"
wait_healthy council 300 || die "gave up on council — see the diagnostic above"
# Non-fatal: wait_healthy already printed an actionable diagnostic for any that lag;
# verify re-checks them. (monitor now uses /livez, so it no longer waits on council.)
for s in council-gateway council-grpc monitor executor-openshell openshell opa agent-signup; do
  wait_healthy "$s" 180 || true
done
ok "workloads settled"

# ── 9. register agent + verify ──────────────────────────────────────────
log "[9/9] Register demo agent + verify"
# The accounts CLI runs inside the council image so the store and the signing
# key resolve exactly as the council resolves them (compose-register-agent.sh
# does the same). Its exit 3 means the store could not be reached — an unknown
# answer, never "the account or token is bad".
council_cli() {
  dc run --rm --no-deps -T --entrypoint python council scripts/agent_accounts.py "$@"
}
cli_err="$(mktemp)"
trap 'rm -f "$cli_err"' EXIT

# Look the account up first. The demo agent is meant to survive re-runs, so an
# existing account is reused, not re-created: re-creating rotates its token and
# invalidates every client still holding the old one. Same created/exists/rotated
# contract as scripts/deploy_stack.sh.
show_rc=0
council_cli show --json "$AGENT_ID" >/dev/null 2>"$cli_err" || show_rc=$?
case "$show_rc" in
  0) account_status=exists ;;
  3) cat "$cli_err" >&2; die "could not reach the account store to look up '$AGENT_ID' — see the error above" ;;
  # "does not exist" — or another error, which the create below then reports itself.
  *) account_status=absent ;;
esac

AGENT_TOKEN=""
case "$account_status" in
  absent)
    # Let the wrapper's stderr through and fail hard. Discarding it turned every
    # registration failure (unreachable database, unsigned store, …) into one
    # indistinguishable warning, after which verify ran against whatever stale
    # NOMOS_AUTH_TOKEN deploy/.env still held and failed somewhere else.
    AGENT_TOKEN="$(AGENT_ROLE="${AGENT_ROLE:-developer}" "$SCRIPT_DIR/compose-register-agent.sh" "$AGENT_ID" \
      | sed -n 's/^AGENT_TOKEN=//p' | tail -n1)" \
      || die "agent registration failed for '$AGENT_ID' — see the error above"
    [[ -n "$AGENT_TOKEN" ]] || die "agent registration did not return a token for '$AGENT_ID'"
    account_status=created
    ;;
  exists)
    case "${AGENT_FORCE_ROTATE:-0}" in
      1|true|yes)
        # Explicit, documented rotation — the same switch scripts/deploy_stack.sh honours.
        rotated="$(council_cli rotate-token --json "$AGENT_ID" 2>"$cli_err")" \
          || { cat "$cli_err" >&2; die "token rotation failed for '$AGENT_ID' — see the error above"; }
        AGENT_TOKEN="$(printf '%s\n' "$rotated" | awk -F'"' '$2 == "token" {print $4; exit}')"
        [[ -n "$AGENT_TOKEN" ]] || die "token rotation did not return a token for '$AGENT_ID'"
        unset rotated
        account_status=rotated
        ;;
      *)
        # Reuse the token deploy/.env holds — once the store confirms it still
        # authenticates this account and council. The store keeps only the hash,
        # so a lost token cannot be recovered, and rotating silently would cut off
        # every other client of this identity: refuse, and say what to do.
        stored_id="$(env_get NOMOS_AGENT_ID)"; AGENT_TOKEN="$(env_get NOMOS_AUTH_TOKEN)"
        verify_rc=0
        if [[ "$stored_id" != "$AGENT_ID" || -z "$AGENT_TOKEN" ]]; then
          verify_rc=1
          printf 'no NOMOS_AGENT_ID=%s / NOMOS_AUTH_TOKEN pair in %s\n' "$AGENT_ID" "$ENV_FILE" >"$cli_err"
        else
          printf '%s' "$AGENT_TOKEN" | council_cli verify-token --token-stdin --expect-council council-prod "$AGENT_ID" \
            >/dev/null 2>"$cli_err" || verify_rc=$?
        fi
        case "$verify_rc" in
          0) ok "account '$AGENT_ID' exists; token in deploy/.env verified — reusing it" ;;
          3)
            cat "$cli_err" >&2
            die "could not reach the account store to verify '$AGENT_ID'; refusing to rotate a credential that may still be valid"
            ;;
          *)
            cat "$cli_err" >&2
            warn "account '$AGENT_ID' exists but $ENV_FILE holds no token that authenticates it (the store keeps only the hash; it cannot be recovered)"
            warn "choose one: restore NOMOS_AGENT_ID/NOMOS_AUTH_TOKEN in $ENV_FILE; --agent-id <new-id> to provision a separate identity; or deliberately rotate this one with AGENT_FORCE_ROTATE=1"
            die "no usable token for '$AGENT_ID'; refusing to mutate an existing account"
            ;;
        esac
        unset stored_id
        ;;
    esac
    ;;
esac

case "$account_status" in
  created|rotated)
    env_set NOMOS_AGENT_ID "$AGENT_ID"; env_set NOMOS_AUTH_TOKEN "$AGENT_TOKEN"
    ok "$account_status agent '$AGENT_ID' (token saved to deploy/.env)"
    # The demo reads NOMOS_AUTH_TOKEN once, at startup, and step 7 started it from
    # the deploy/.env of that moment. Recreate it now that the credential is
    # persisted; otherwise it keeps running on the old (now invalid) or empty token
    # while verify — which is handed the token directly — passes.
    dc up -d --force-recreate --no-deps demo
    wait_healthy demo 120 || die "demo did not become healthy after the token change"
    ok "demo recreated with the new token"
    ;;
esac

AGENT_ID="$AGENT_ID" AGENT_TOKEN="$AGENT_TOKEN" "$SCRIPT_DIR/compose-verify.sh" \
  || die "verification failed — see the checks above"

# ── summary ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
cat <<EOF

${C_G}${C_B}Nomos dev stack (docker-compose) is up and verified.${C_0}

  council /mcp : http://localhost:${GATEWAY_PORT}/mcp     Bearer: $(env_get MONITOR_MCP_PROXY_TOKEN)
  monitor      : http://localhost:${MONITOR_PORT}/        $(env_get MONITOR_DASHBOARD_USER) / $(env_get MONITOR_DASHBOARD_PASSWORD)
  agent-signup : https://localhost:${SIGNUP_PORT}/        $(env_get NOMOS_SIGNUP_ADMIN_USER) / $(env_get NOMOS_SIGNUP_ADMIN_PASSWORD)
                 council-create login:                    $(env_get NOMOS_SIGNUP_COUNCIL_ADMIN_USER) / $(env_get NOMOS_SIGNUP_COUNCIL_ADMIN_PASSWORD)
  demo         : http://localhost:${DEMO_PORT}/
  demo agent   : ${AGENT_ID}  (token in deploy/.env: NOMOS_AUTH_TOKEN)

All dev credentials live in ${ENV_FILE} (gitignored). Re-run compose-up.sh anytime
(idempotent); --regenerate-secrets to rotate; compose-down.sh to tear down.
EOF

{{- if (.Values.vault).dev.enabled }}
{{- /*
Bootstrap the dev Vault for service mode:
  - enable the transit engine + two ed25519 signing keys
  - enable kubernetes auth and bind the `nomos-signer` role to the chart SA
The council/executor present a projected token scoped to audience "vault"; that
token cannot call the TokenReview API itself, so Vault needs a reviewer JWT with
the apiserver audience. We mint a non-expiring one via a service-account-token
Secret and grant the SA system:auth-delegator.
*/}}
apiVersion: v1
kind: Secret
metadata:
  name: {{ include "nomos.fullname" . }}-vault-reviewer-token
  labels:
    {{- include "nomos.labels" . | nindent 4 }}
    app.kubernetes.io/component: vault-bootstrap
  annotations:
    kubernetes.io/service-account.name: {{ include "nomos.serviceAccountName" . }}
type: kubernetes.io/service-account-token
---
apiVersion: rbac.authorization.k8s.io/v1
kind: ClusterRoleBinding
metadata:
  name: {{ include "nomos.fullname" . }}-vault-auth-delegator
  labels:
    {{- include "nomos.labels" . | nindent 4 }}
    app.kubernetes.io/component: vault-bootstrap
roleRef:
  apiGroup: rbac.authorization.k8s.io
  kind: ClusterRole
  name: system:auth-delegator
subjects:
  - kind: ServiceAccount
    name: {{ include "nomos.serviceAccountName" . }}
    namespace: {{ .Release.Namespace }}
---
apiVersion: batch/v1
kind: Job
metadata:
  name: {{ include "nomos.fullname" . }}-vault-bootstrap
  labels:
    {{- include "nomos.labels" . | nindent 4 }}
    app.kubernetes.io/component: vault-bootstrap
  annotations:
    helm.sh/hook: post-install,post-upgrade
    helm.sh/hook-weight: "-5"
    helm.sh/hook-delete-policy: before-hook-creation,hook-succeeded
spec:
  backoffLimit: 10
  ttlSecondsAfterFinished: 600
  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        {{- include "nomos.selectorLabels" . | nindent 8 }}
        app.kubernetes.io/component: vault-bootstrap
    spec:
      restartPolicy: Never
      serviceAccountName: {{ include "nomos.serviceAccountName" . }}
      automountServiceAccountToken: true
      securityContext:
        runAsNonRoot: true
        runAsUser: 100
        runAsGroup: 1000
        fsGroup: 1000
      containers:
        - name: bootstrap
          image: {{ include "nomos.image" (dict "root" . "name" "vault") | quote }}
          imagePullPolicy: {{ include "nomos.pullPolicy" (dict "root" . "name" "vault") }}
          env:
            - name: VAULT_ADDR
              value: {{ printf "http://%s-vault:%v" (include "nomos.fullname" .) .Values.vault.dev.service.port | quote }}
            - name: VAULT_TOKEN
              valueFrom:
                {{- include "nomos.secretKeyRef" (dict "root" . "key" .Values.secrets.keys.vaultDevRootToken) | nindent 16 }}
            - name: TRANSIT_MOUNT
              value: {{ .Values.signing.vault.transitMount | quote }}
            - name: COUNCIL_KEY_ID
              value: {{ .Values.signing.councilKeyId | quote }}
            - name: EXECUTOR_KEY_ID
              value: {{ .Values.signing.executorKeyId | quote }}
            - name: VAULT_ROLE
              value: {{ .Values.signing.vault.auth.role | quote }}
            - name: VAULT_AUDIENCE
              value: {{ .Values.signing.vault.auth.audience | quote }}
            - name: SA_NAME
              value: {{ include "nomos.serviceAccountName" . | quote }}
            - name: SA_NAMESPACE
              value: {{ .Release.Namespace | quote }}
          command: ["sh", "-c"]
          args:
            - |
              set -eu
              echo "waiting for vault to be ready..."
              until vault status >/dev/null 2>&1; do sleep 2; done

              echo "enabling transit engine + ed25519 signing keys..."
              vault secrets enable -path="$TRANSIT_MOUNT" transit 2>/dev/null || true
              vault write -f "$TRANSIT_MOUNT/keys/$COUNCIL_KEY_ID" type=ed25519
              vault write -f "$TRANSIT_MOUNT/keys/$EXECUTOR_KEY_ID" type=ed25519

              echo "writing signer policy..."
              printf '%s\n' \
                "path \"$TRANSIT_MOUNT/sign/$COUNCIL_KEY_ID\" { capabilities = [\"create\", \"update\"] }" \
                "path \"$TRANSIT_MOUNT/verify/$COUNCIL_KEY_ID\" { capabilities = [\"create\", \"update\"] }" \
                "path \"$TRANSIT_MOUNT/keys/$COUNCIL_KEY_ID\" { capabilities = [\"read\"] }" \
                "path \"$TRANSIT_MOUNT/sign/$EXECUTOR_KEY_ID\" { capabilities = [\"create\", \"update\"] }" \
                "path \"$TRANSIT_MOUNT/verify/$EXECUTOR_KEY_ID\" { capabilities = [\"create\", \"update\"] }" \
                "path \"$TRANSIT_MOUNT/keys/$EXECUTOR_KEY_ID\" { capabilities = [\"read\"] }" \
                | vault policy write "$VAULT_ROLE" -

              echo "enabling kubernetes auth + binding the signer role..."
              vault auth enable kubernetes 2>/dev/null || true
              vault write auth/kubernetes/config \
                kubernetes_host="https://kubernetes.default.svc" \
                kubernetes_ca_cert=@/var/run/reviewer/ca.crt \
                token_reviewer_jwt=@/var/run/reviewer/token
              vault write "auth/kubernetes/role/$VAULT_ROLE" \
                bound_service_account_names="$SA_NAME" \
                bound_service_account_namespaces="$SA_NAMESPACE" \
                audience="$VAULT_AUDIENCE" \
                policies="$VAULT_ROLE" \
                ttl=20m

              echo "vault bootstrap complete."
          securityContext:
            allowPrivilegeEscalation: false
            readOnlyRootFilesystem: false
            capabilities:
              drop: ["ALL"]
            seccompProfile:
              type: RuntimeDefault
          resources:
            requests:
              cpu: 25m
              memory: 64Mi
            limits:
              cpu: 200m
              memory: 128Mi
          volumeMounts:
            - name: reviewer-token
              mountPath: /var/run/reviewer
              readOnly: true
      volumes:
        - name: reviewer-token
          secret:
            secretName: {{ include "nomos.fullname" . }}-vault-reviewer-token
{{- end }}
